notes.title: 🔧 UI Update Live! Spinner: Rogueblade Demo Updated
notes.content:
Hey Spinner warriors! 🌀
A new user interface (UI) update has arrived for the Spinner: Rogueblade demo. We've revamped everything from menus to in-game experience based on your feedback.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648783/900b8ac558dafa7f31f4cf5c4b649e01db5bcbda.jpg"]
🖥️ What's Changed?
Modern and Theme-Appropriate Menu Design:
With brand new visuals and animations, everything now fits better with the Spinner: Rogueblade universe.

Detailed Settings Menu:
We've gone beyond the old plain menu. Explore more options from sound and music levels to graphics. (It might still be basic, but it's improving!)

Gamepad Support in Main Menu:
You can now navigate menus with a gamepad. We're one step closer to that console feel!

More Intuitive In-Game UI:
Health, energy, and character icons are now clearer and more functional.
[hr][/hr]
🛠️ These improvements came thanks to your feedback. Keep sharing your ideas during the demo process — because we're shaping this world together.

💬 We're waiting for your comments!
🧡 Thank you for your support!
